variables.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
variables.notes: Record the secret-store reference or env var metadata only; never paste the value.

variables.name: SITE_URL
variables.notes: Must match the production auth service URL.

variables.name: BANATA_AUTH_APP_SECRET
variables.notes: Production app secret reference, separated from vault and token signing custody.

variables.name: BANATA_JWT_SIGNING_KEY_KMS_ID
variables.notes: KMS/HSM/external reference for JWT signing custody.

variables.name: BANATA_VAULT_KMS_KEY_ID
variables.notes: KMS/HSM/external reference for vault encryption custody.

variables.name: BANATA_REFRESH_TOKEN_PEPPER_KMS_ID
variables.notes: KMS/HSM/external reference for refresh-token pepper custody.

variables.name: BANATA_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_PEPPER
variables.notes: Production webhook pepper reference; do not paste raw value.

variables.name: BANATA_API_KEY
variables.notes: Customer app server API key. It must not be available in browser/public env.

variables.name: BANATA_AUTH_URL
variables.notes: Customer server proxy target for Banata Auth.

variables.name: VITE_BANATA_HOSTED_AUTH_URL
variables.notes: Public hosted UI URL; no secret value.
